name: Madhyamik Drop-out Coaching
benefit: Special coaching is being provided to the Madhyamik failed ST students for a period of 7 (seven) months through NGO run Coaching centres.. Stipend @ Rs. 65/- per student per day is provided to the hostellers.
eligibility_rules: Unsuccessful Madhyamik ST students from interior Tribal Areas/BPL shall get preference in admission at such coaching centre.
documents_required: Aadhaar NumberCaste Certificate (signed by competent authority) Marksheet of the Latest Educational QualificationDomicile
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline The concerned DM/SDM will collect the list of students from the NGOs (Madhyamik Drop-out Coaching Centre) and send the list to the Directorate of Tribal Welfare.
